question: Who has been awarded the title 'Governor of the Year' for 2023 by Central Banking, an international economic research journal?
solution:
The correct answer is **Shaktikanta Das**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Shaktikanta Das has been awarded the title 'Governor of the Year' for 2023 by Central Banking. Central Banking is an international economic research journal. The award recognizes Shaktikanta Das's leadership and contributions to the Indian economy. Shaktikanta Das is the current Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The award highlights his role in navigating the economic challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
 

 Central Banking
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Definition
 Central Banking refers to the management of a country's currency, money supply, and interest rates by its central bank.
 
 

 Functions
 The primary functions include monetary policy implementation, financial stability, and regulation of financial institutions.
 
 

 Examples
 Major central banks include the Federal Reserve (USA), European Central Bank (EU), and the Reserve Bank of India (India).
 
 

 Importance
 Central banks play a critical role in managing economic stability, controlling inflation, and stimulating economic growth.
 
 

 Tools
 Common tools used by central banks include interest rate adjustments, open market operations, and reserve requirements.
